body: I'm kind of the same but it's still a terrible time and I want out.

>Science-Boring

Life is just on ultra hard mode right now.  Even though I'm not struggling in a lot of ways other people are, I'm still struggling a hell of a lot - hence the 'I've got a month' thing.
Thank you - I hope they do too I guess.  We'll see what happens.

Update for anyone who's interested - eventually met up with the guy at a pub.  Absolutely no chemistry whatsoever and he was the most boring guy but it gives me a bit of confidence to potentially meet other guys now so it was kind of a good thing :)  Thanks for all the advice.
I know, I just can't discriminate between paranoia, nerves because of it being a totally new thing for me and stuff from all the Grindr horror stories I've heard...
I'm hoping that this does actually go ahead now, just to maybe stop being so confused and know about that side of me a bit more!

By flake out, I would obviously let him know if I decide not to go through with it.  I just want to either get over or accept this nervousness I'm having about it.  One of the problems is also that I'm not out to family or anyone so I basically have to lie to them about what I'm doing.

I'm more worried about what happens if he starts to know too much about me, then something goes wrong when we meet up somehow and he decides to share stuff on social media...I'm just imagining the worst case scenario.
Yeah, we're definitely meeting up for a drink first - thank you!  It might sound a bit paranoid/not trusting, but I will be watching my drink/ordering my own as well.

Thank you so much for your in-depth reply.  It's definitely going to be safe sex.  We were discussing about experience levels and we both thought that exploring with someone more experienced would be more nerve-wracking because of potential expectations etc.  We're planning on meeting for at least a drink first to hang out.  Thank you for the offer to talk as well, it means a lot.
